principles: Functional authority is preserved before structural optimization.
The crate dependency graph is acyclic.
Security choke points may be intentional and must not be removed to improve a graph metric.
One runtime composition root owns wiring; leaf crates do not import upward.
Workflow transition and finalization remain single logical authorities.

vertices.responsibility: Stable wire contracts, error facts, enums, schemas, and source compatibility constants.
Pure domain types, schema validation, redaction, fingerprints, URL/path/command policy, patch parsing, and authority-neutral evaluation.
SQLite schema, migrations, repositories, capability registry/signing, copied-state differential tooling, and transaction mechanics.
Process lifecycle, TTY, toolchains, isolation, and owned child processes.
OAuth, MCP, HTTP, public catalog, and request boundary.
Deterministic workflow transition planning, private vault, verifier/finalizer gates, typed L2 capability use, and project semantics.
Single composition root, remaining bounded adapters, tool backend wiring, operator session, and distribution composition.
Operator commands and presentation; never an authority source.

edges.guard: Bounded fixed-provider or isolated execution adapter
MTM release identity, executable hash, and no-Python linkage verified
Only the mtm command starts MTM production sessions
Frozen Re-CTM 0.3.0 source and wheel provenance remain recorded
Wheel restoration and Re-CTM server probe succeed
Only the re-ctm command selects the Re-CTM installation

invariants.statement: Exactly one production authority exists per component.
Rust shadow execution is read-only and side-effect-free.
The crate dependency graph is a directed acyclic graph.
Native arbitrary execution crosses the isolated-worker boundary and cannot reach the private vault.
Workflow transition planning has one logical authority.
Only the mechanical finalizer publishes verified artifacts or verified claim revisions.
The observer can display redacted facts but cannot authorize, persist, or transition state.
Graph metrics never override functional or security boundaries.
The mtm command namespace belongs exclusively to MTM and selects only a hash-verified MTM Rust release.
MTM and Re-CTM use distinct commands, installation roots, environment-variable namespaces, and default runtime-data roots; neither project provides a compatibility alias for the other.
